entry.title: [UPDATED] GHSA-h4f5-h82v-5w4r: SurrealDB has an Uncaught Exception in Function Generating Random Time
entry.content:
SurrealDB has an Uncaught Exception in Function Generating Random Time

Aliases: CVE-2024-58357

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H

Affected:

  • surrealdb — fixed in 2.1.0
  • surrealdb-core — fixed in 2.1.0

The `rand::time()` function in SurrealQL generates a random time from an optional range of two Unix timestamps. Due to the underlying use of `timestamp_opt` from the `chrono` crate, this function could potentially return `None` in some instances, leading to a panic when `unwrap` was called on its result in order to return a SurrealQL `datetime` type to the caller of the function. ### Impact A client that is authorized to run queries in a SurrealDB server would be able to make repeated (in the order of millions) calls to `rand::time()` in order to reliably trigger a panic. This would crash the server, leading to denial of service. ### Patches The function has been updated in to guarantee that some `datetime` is returned or that an error is otherwise gracefully handled. - Version 2.1.0 …
